2607.21535.title: Windowed-MTP: Removing the Full-Context Draft-KV Tax at Million-Token Context
2607.21535.paper_summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by having a cheap draft propose tokens that a target verifies in parallel. Frontier models increasingly ship a built-in Multi-Token-Prediction (MTP/NEXTN) draft head under the assumption that the draft is negligibly cheap. At million-token context this breaks: an MTP draft head typically runs full attention over the entire KV cache at every draft step, so its read grows linearly with context and comes to dominate the draft cost -- precisely where speculation is most valuable. The effect compounds with draft length (a deep native draft can turn net-negative, slower than no speculation) and sharpens under hybrid/linear-attention targets, where cheaper verification leaves the draft's full-attention read exposed. We apply a StreamingLLM-style sliding window plus attention sink to the draft's attention only (Windowed-MTP), leaving full-attention verification intact. It is training-free, drop-in, and lossless by construction: the full-attention target still decides every accepted token, so windowing changes only which tokens are proposed, never which are accepted. It bounds the draft's KV working set to a constant, dropping ~99% of KV entries at 1M. Across three architecture families (Qwen GDN-MoE 35B/122B and a Mamba2-hybrid NoPE 120B) at 1M context on a single GPU in SGLang, windowing cuts the per-decode-step cost over the shipping native MTP draft by +28% to +44%, an input-invariant margin that widens with context. Since per-token latency is this cost divided by acceptance length, at matched acceptance end-to-end decode latency improves by the same amount, and more where windowing also lifts acceptance, while preserving the target's verified output distribution. Finally, the unread draft KV -- 7.7-11% of total KV at 1M -- is reclaimed via a compact ring buffer at no acceptance or quality cost.
2607.21535.paper_summary_zh: 推測解碼透過讓便宜的草稿提出令牌，並讓目標並行驗證，來加速自回歸生成。前沿模型越來越多地在假設草稿幾乎無成本的情況下，內建多令牌預測（MTP/NEXTN）草稿頭。在百萬令牌的上下文中，這會失效：MTP草稿頭通常在每個草稿步驟中對整個KV快取進行全面注意，因此其讀取隨著上下文線性增長，並主導草稿成本——正是推測最有價值的地方。這種效果隨著草稿長度的增加而加劇（深度本地草稿可能變得淨負，速度比沒有推測還慢），並在混合/線性注意目標下變得更加明顯，因為更便宜的驗證使得草稿的全面注意讀取暴露出來。我們對草稿的注意力僅應用了一種StreamingLLM風格的滑動窗口加上注意力接收器（Windowed-MTP），保持全面注意驗證不變。這是無需訓練的、即插即用的，並且在結構上是無損的：全面注意目標仍然決定每個被接受的令牌，因此窗口化僅改變提出的令牌，而不改變被接受的令牌。它將草稿的KV工作集限制為一個常數，在1M時丟棄約99%的KV條目。在三個架構系列（Qwen GDN-MoE 35B/122B和一個Mamba2混合NoPE 120B）中，在SGLang的單個GPU上以1M上下文，窗口化將每次解碼步驟的成本比運行中的本地MTP草稿降低了+28%到+44%，這是一個與輸入無關的利潤，並隨著上下文的增加而擴大。由於每個令牌的延遲是這個成本除以接受長度，因此在匹配的接受端到端解碼延遲上改善了相同的幅度，並且在窗口化也提升接受時改善更多，同時保持目標的驗證輸出分佈。最後，未讀的草稿KV——在1M時佔總KV的7.7-11%——通過緊湊的環形緩衝區回收，沒有接受或質量成本。
